svg.text: I²C BUS / Two shared signal wires
TB2 / NEGATIVE POWER BUS — COMMON GROUND
POWER: Battery positive passes through the fuse and main switch before feeding the positive bus and converter.
GROUND: Battery negative, servo grounds, converter return and electronics grounds share the common reference.
LOGIC: The converter is set to 5 V and supplies the Nano, PCA9685 VCC and IMU through the breadboard rail.
CONTROL: SDA and SCL form the shared I²C bus; twelve separate PWM signal wires connect the PCA9685 to the servos.
JUNCTIONS: Filled dots indicate electrical connections. Wire crossings without dots are not connected.
